description: This file defines a ShellExecutor utility in Swift that executes shell commands asynchronously, captures their output, handles timeouts, and reports execution results. It also interacts with external processes and manages process I/O via pipes.

classes.name: ShellExecutor
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to run shell commands with detailed output capture and timeout handling.

methods.name: runDetailed
methods.description: Executes a command with arguments in a specified directory and environment, with optional timeout, returning detailed execution results.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Simplifies running a command and returns a response indicating success or failure, combining stdout and stderr.

classes.name: ShellResult
classes.description: A struct encapsulating the output and status of a shell command execution.

methods.name: runDetailed
methods.description: Executes a command asynchronously, capturing stdout, stderr, exit code, timeout, and success status.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs a command and returns a response object summarizing the success status, message, and payload.
